tools.description: Returns structured detail for one client, given a ref from searchClients: name, company, status, created date, and project/invoice counts.

ref.description: An opaque record reference returned by searchClients.

tools.name: getClientDetail

tools.description: Returns a summary of the current organization's business state: client/project/task/invoice counts and status breakdowns, recent invoices, and upcoming/overdue tasks. Takes no arguments.
tools.name: getOrganizationSummary

tools.description: Searches the current organization's clients by name/company and optional status. Returns up to 10 matches, most recently created first.

query.description: Optional text to match against client name/company.

tools.name: searchClients

tools.description: Searches the current organization's invoices by invoice number/project/client name and optional status. Returns up to 10 matches, soonest due date first (invoices with no due date last). Never includes notes, internal notes, line items, or any payment/provider details.

query.description: Optional text to match against invoice number, project name, or client name.

tools.name: searchInvoices

tools.description: Searches the current organization's projects by name/client name, optional status, and optional client reference. Returns up to 10 matches, most recently created first.

clientRef.description: Optional client reference (from searchClients) to filter by.

query.description: Optional text to match against project or client name.

tools.name: searchProjects

tools.description: Searches the current organization's tasks by title/project name, optional status, priority, and due-before date. Returns up to 15 matches, soonest due date first (tasks with no due date last).

dueBefore.description: Optional ISO date; only tasks due on or before this date are returned.

query.description: Optional text to match against task title or project name.

tools.name: searchTasks
